prompt: Who was the successor of the Egyptian Pharaoh that was in power when the Treasury of Atreus was completed?
answer: The Treasury of Atreus was completed around **1250 BCE**, during the reign of **Ramesses II** of Egypt (c. 1279–1213 BCE). Ramesses II’s successor was his son, **Merneptah** (c. 1213–1203 BCE).
